title.narrative: Eco-theology and social justice: Empowering Marginalized Communities in Upper Egypt

description.narrative: This project aims to make a comprehensive Eco theology study program with a Christian background, designed to address environmental challenges, promote social justice, and empower marginalized communities in Upper Egypt. The program will consist of 6 modules. The program culminates in a conference that showcases the students' projects and emphasizes the importance of social justice. Additionally, students will create and share an environmental chart with their communities, promoting awareness and action. The important part is to develop a study curriculum where key people in the community are trained in Eco-theology and then develop local green initiatives to be implemented in / around the villages they come from. Later we will have a ToT, selected from the participants' own environmental green initiatives / mini-projects become "degree projects" to get Anafora diploma at the program completion.
